verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is explicitly designed as a terminal-based coding agent with extensive agentic features (codebase editing, debugging, automation, MCP servers) per official docs. However, extensive community/hands-on evidence reports it frequently fails at basic agentic tasks—getting stuck in loops, ignoring context files, rewriting files empty, and in one case causing irreversible data loss—directly contradicting vendor claims of reliable local agentic coding.
